content.text: Cocoa Beach Air Show returns April 15-16, 2023 Who’s Flying! Early performer announcements for 2023! U.S. AIR FORCE THUNDERBIRDS DOUGLAS C-47 TICO BELL JOHN BLACK VIP & Premium Viewing FLIGHT LINE CLUB VIP The Flight Line Club is the ultimate spot on the beach to experience the Air Show. Enjoy this VIP beach experience featuring tents for shade and eating, a catered lunch right on the beach with soft drinks water and beer and VIP parking. $159 MORE INFO Save $140 DROP ZONE BEACH Enjoy convenient amenities like restrooms, hand sanitizing stations, plus food and beverage stands so you can stay safe and separated from any crowds. Professional narration and music will further enhance your viewing experience! $22.50 MORE INFO Save50% SAND BOXES Sand Boxes accommodate 4 people in your own reserved beach area where you can relax and enjoy the Air Show with your family or friends knowing you’ll be separated from others.
